#------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# geocentric_unga_main_button_effects.txt
# Generated by RStellarisGui. Standalone file; it does not override any vanilla button effect.
#
# An effectbuttonType.effect names a top-level key in this file. Verified against vanilla
# 4.4.6 common/button_effects/example.txt.
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

geocentric_unga_open_main = {
	potential = {
		is_scope_type = planet
		has_planet_flag = geocentric_earth
		owner = {
			is_ai = no
		}
		# IDEMPOTENCE GUARD (duplicate-instance protection).
		# The UNGA windows are `is_triggered_only` diplomatic events with `fire_only_once = no`, so
		# nothing in the engine de-duplicates them: every press of this button queued another
		# geocentric_unga.1 instance, which is how several windows could sit in the queue at once.
		# Vanilla guards the identical situation with `has_active_event`
		# (common/scripted_triggers/02_scripted_triggers_caravaneers.txt:9-19, commented
		# "# prevents diplo duplication", used at events/caravaneer_events.txt:106-134).
		# `has_active_event` is a country trigger, so it is evaluated in the country scope here.
		# This is safe *here* because a button's potential is evaluated while the window is still on
		# screen -- unlike at option-execution time, where the engine has already consumed the event
		# and the same trigger reads false (measured; see zz_geocentric_unga_effects.txt).
		# Nav options inside the windows are deliberately NOT guarded: selecting one consumes the
		# event it belongs to, which is what makes the sidebar switch panels instead of stacking.
		owner = {
			NOT = {
				has_active_event = {
					geocentric_unga.1
					geocentric_unga.2
					geocentric_unga.3
					geocentric_unga.4
					geocentric_unga.5
					geocentric_unga.6
				}
			}
		}
	}
	allow = {
		always = yes
	}
	effect = {
		owner = {
			country_event = { id = "geocentric_unga.1" }
		}
	}
}

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The window close button X, as a button effect.
#
# WHY THIS IS AN EFFECT AT ALL
# `name = "close"` is one of the 30 engine contract names each window must declare; renaming or
# removing it is not an option. The engine resolves a click on it by SELECTING OPTION 0 of the
# event, which for these windows is the `unga_sidebar_main` row whose hidden_effect re-fired
# geocentric_unga.1 - i.e. the close button re-opened the window it had just closed. The engine
# logs this plainly: `selectedOption 0` immediately after the click.
#
# This button effect runs ONE STEP BEFORE that selection (verified in logs/game.log: the
# "CLOSE button pressed" log line is written before the `selectedOption 0` line), so it is the
# only place that can tell the option "this selection came from the close button, do not re-open".
# The flag is consumed by geocentric_unga_main_option_effect, which every window's option 0 calls.
#
# The `effect` field is valid on effectbuttonType (see vanilla common/button_effects/example.txt
# and interface/fleet_view.gui:709-722); the element's name, sprite, position, orientation and
# clicksound are unchanged from the buttonType this replaced.
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
geocentric_unga_diag_close = {
	potential = {
		always = yes
	}
	allow = {
		always = yes
	}
	effect = {
		owner = {
			set_country_flag = geocentric_unga_close_pressed
		}
	}
}
